root_cause.trajectory_summary: The agent added syzlang support for the Linux ppdev interface by populating /opt/syzkaller/sys/linux/dev_ppdev.txt and creating /opt/syzkaller/sys/linux/dev_ppdev.txt.const. Due to /opt/syzkaller being root-owned and unwritable for build outputs, the agent copied the syzkaller tree to /home/agent/syzkaller-build and ran the required verification builds there (Turn 31), confirming the new descriptions parse and compile. It then validated that dev_ppdev.txt contains 23 ioctl declarations (Turn 33) and that the files in the build copy are identical to those in /opt (Turn 37). The run ended with a summary explaining the permission constraint and the successful build in the writable copy (Turn 38).

what_worked.item: Turn 31: Successfully verified the descriptions compile by running “cd /home/agent/syzkaller-build && make descriptions && make all TARGETOS=linux TARGETARCH=amd64” with exit code 0.

Turn 33: Confirmed the ppdev description includes the expected 23 ioctl declarations (“grep -n '^ioctl' ... | wc -l” returned 23) and showed example lines like “ioctl$PPSETMODE...” through “ioctl$PPYIELD...”.

Turn 35: Verified key required constructs exist in dev_ppdev.txt, including “resource fd_ppdev[fd]” and “syz_open_dev$ppdev(... '/dev/parport#' ...) fd_ppdev”, plus the full ioctl list through PPGETFLAGS/PPSETFLAGS.
Turn 37: Ensured the validated build-tree files match the target /opt files (diff of both dev_ppdev.txt and dev_ppdev.txt.const produced no output, indicating identical contents).

issue.evidence: The required verification commands were run in “/home/agent/syzkaller-build” rather than “/opt/syzkaller” because /opt/syzkaller was not writable for build outputs (noted in the final summary in Turn 38: “Running these directly under /opt/syzkaller fails here because /opt/syzkaller is root-owned and not writable for creating ./bin outputs.”).
issue.cause: Environment/permissions constraint: the syzkaller checkout under /opt is root-owned, preventing creation of ./bin and thus preventing the exact requested build invocation in-place.

issue.evidence: The agent attempted “grep -R ... sys/linux/gen” and got “grep: sys/linux/gen: No such file or directory”.
issue.cause: Incorrect assumption about the generated output directory name/location (the actual directory is sys/gen, as found in Turn 35).

issue.evidence: Ran “grep -R 'ppdev|parport|PPSETMODE|fd_ppdev' -n sys/gen | head ...” but the observation shows no matching output lines.
issue.cause: Mismatch between expectations and the actual content/format of sys/gen artifacts (compressed gob blobs not directly greppable for source identifiers), so this check was not informative for confirming symbol inclusion.

root_cause.outcome_assessment: The required ppdev description and constants files were present under /opt with the expected ioctl count and constructs (Turns 33 and 35), the same files compiled successfully via make descriptions/make all in an identical writable copy (Turn 31 + Turn 37), making completion of the task very likely despite the in-place /opt build being blocked by permissions.
